headline: Sensex and Nifty rally as record foreign inflows and banking sector strength drive markets to new highs

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Record foreign fund inflows have significantly fueled the Indian stock market's surge throughout November
Strong performance in the banking sector propelled the Nifty Bank index to a record high
Moderating crude oil prices provided a supportive environment for the domestic equity rally
Positive momentum continued for a second day despite concerns over a global market sell-off
whatHappening: The Sensex closed 427 points higher while the Nifty50 ended the session at 25,387
SEBI is weighing new restrictions on leveraged stock purchases to address rising retail market exposure
NMDC announced plans to expand its pellet production capacity to 24 million tonnes
Data shows 60% of NSE stocks are still trading below their December 2025 closing levels
summary: Indian indices rallied as Sensex gained 427 points and Nifty Bank hit record highs, driven by strong foreign inflows. SEBI is considering curbs on leveraged purchases to manage retail exposure amid the surge. Despite the rally, analysts warn that many stocks remain below 2025 levels and growth premiums face tests.
